title: Open speech leaderboard adds Hindi and Indian English
friendlyTitle: Speech recognition tests now cover Hindi and Indian English
summary: Hugging Face and Voice Arena are expanding the Open ASR Leaderboard with public evaluation for Hindi and Indian English. The work also highlights why a single word-error score can hide substantial differences across accents, ages and other speaker characteristics.
friendlySummary: An open leaderboard can now compare speech-to-text models in Hindi and Indian English. It also shows that one overall score may hide poor results for some speakers.
whyItMatters: Speech tools should be evaluated on the people who will actually use them. Teams building transcription or voice products can use broader benchmarks as a starting point, then test local accents and real acoustic conditions before deployment.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A voice tool should understand the people who use it, not only the speakers in a narrow test set.
